body.prompt: Daylight under a heavy grey winter sky, a column of Roman legionaries in iron helmets and dark cloaks marches through falling snow beside a frozen river while the bearded Roman emperor in a crimson cloak rides a black horse above them.

Daylight in falling snow, medium shot of the grey-haired bearded Roman emperor in a crimson cloak and bronze cuirass riding a black horse toward the camera, helmeted soldiers marching behind him along a frozen river.
Daylight close-up under a cold grey sky, the Roman emperor with grey curly hair and beard looks straight ahead, snowflakes settling on his crimson wool cloak and bronze brooch.

Daylight in a dusty Roman street market under a salmon cloth awning, stalls of green olives and bread in the foreground while a woman vendor and a young man talk across a table in slanting morning sun.

Daylight medium shot at a Roman market stall, a woman with braided hair leans over loaves of bread and jars of olives bargaining with a curly-haired young man, townspeople passing in sunlit haze behind.
Daylight close shot at a Roman market stall, an older woman vendor and a curly-haired young man lean toward each other over piled loaves of bread, fish on ice and passers-by blurred behind them.
Night in a dim stone room lit by a small oil lamp, a bearded man in a dark tunic sits beside a small empty bed and turns a carved wooden toy horse in both hands, looking down at it.
Night, dim lamp-lit medium shot of a bearded man in a dark tunic bowed over a small carved wooden toy horse held in his hands, his face heavy with grief in deep shadow.
Night close-up in near darkness lit by faint warm lamp light, a bearded man lowers his eyes in silent grief, his brow furrowed.

Daylight in a crowded Roman street market with a temple front in the hazy background, a baker in a sleeveless tunic works behind bowls of dark and green olives and piles of bread while a young mother holds a baby beside him.

Daylight medium shot at a Roman market stall, a smiling man in a rough tunic looks down at a baby held by a young mother with braided hair, bowls of olives and loaves of bread in front, a sunlit crowd behind.
Daylight close shot in a sunlit Roman market, a young mother with braided hair smiles down at the baby in her arms who gazes up at her, blurred townspeople and awnings behind.
Daylight in a sunlit garden with olive trees and a colonnade, a grey-bearded old teacher in a plain tunic reads aloud from an open scroll while three young men lean in close around him.
Daylight medium shot in an olive garden, a grey-bearded old teacher looks up from his scroll with a gentle smile as three young students beside him listen and study the page.
Daylight close-up in a sunlit garden, a grey-bearded old teacher smiles warmly at the camera while two young students at his shoulders look on thoughtfully, olive leaves blurred behind.
Daylight at bright noon in the Roman Forum, a speaker in a white toga with a purple stripe raises his right hand above a crowd of men in tunics, marble columns and temples in hard sunlight behind.
Daylight medium shot in the Roman Forum, a man in a white toga with a purple stripe holds his open hand raised while the crowd behind him watches in silence, sunlit columns in the haze.
Daylight close shot in the Roman Forum, a stern short-haired man in a white and purple toga keeps his palm raised and looks past the camera, blurred faces of the crowd and columns behind him.
Daylight in golden fields, an ox cart loaded with firewood rolls away along a dirt road beneath the tall stone arches of a Roman aqueduct, a second aqueduct line on the horizon under a pale blue sky.
Daylight wide shot through the stone arches of a Roman aqueduct, a small ox cart with its driver moves slowly down a dusty road into dry golden fields in afternoon sun.
Daylight between two massive stone piers of a Roman aqueduct, a lone ox cart grows small on a straight dirt road toward a distant line of arches across golden fields.
Daylight close shot on a hilltop, a lean short-haired Roman man wrapped in a dark navy cloak gazes out with a hard, thoughtful face, red-tiled rooftops of the city soft and blurred far below.
Daylight at morning, thick mist lifts off forested mountain slopes and reveals sunlit peaks under dark storm clouds.
Daylight aerial view of a rounded forested mountain summit glowing gold in morning sun, ranges of peaks and drifting cloud behind under a dark blue sky.
Daylight slow push toward a sunlit rocky mountain top dotted with pines, shadowed valleys below and a faint rainbow in the distant rain cloud.
